description: Legitimately acquire and KEEP an authenticated session (through MFA/OTP) so you can test the post-auth attack surface, and hand that session to your tools without leaking secrets. Load when the high-value classes (IDOR/BOLA, mass assignment, injection on real data APIs) are blocked behind login/SMS-OTP/TOTP, when tokens keep expiring mid-test, or when Burp/Playwright keep logging you out. Distinct from attacking auth — this one authenticates and reuses the session.
